notes: No usable four-year plan: the official Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence Four Year Academic Plan PDF decoded to garbled binary/glyph text, not readable plan text (see the Program's reviewNotes and docs/project/owner-review.md). This plan is constructed from the catalog's 16-course requirement list alone; term placement spreads the 9 core courses, 6 specialization courses and capstone across 8 terms in catalog order, with the capstone placed in the final term as the catalog specifies. Gen Ed and college-requirement (e.g. MATH115) slots are left out: only the major is audited.

Language and Cognition Specialization (catalog: at least 2 LING and 2 PHIL) filled with LING311 and LING312 (at-least-2-LING slot), PHIL202 and PHIL360 (at-least-2-PHIL slot), and LING440 and PHIL366 (the 2 additional-from-either slot), all real courses from the Academic Catalog's own list for this specialization.
